solutions.explanation:
The choices are squares, so look for a way to make two equal factors. Multiplying \(19.98\) by \(100\) moves its decimal point two places right, and multiplying \(1.998\) by \(1000\) moves its decimal point three places right:
\[
\begin{aligned}
100\times19.98&=1998,\\
1000\times1.998&=1998.
\end{aligned}
\]
We may change the order and grouping of factors in a product. Therefore the original expression equals \(1998\times1998=(1998)^2\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
